It's been a really bad month (and year) for OT cybersecurity due to a wave of new, high-impact vulnerabilities, attacks on supermarket refrigerators and blood banks, and attacks on water utilities. The situation is far more complicated than it looks, and calling the people who support and purchase these systems incompetent won't fix it. The problem lies in the convergence of IT and OT, which began 15 to 20 years ago when industrial devices and network infrastructure became more bespoke and heterogeneous, leading to a loss of security by obscurity.
